name: cloudtak-plugin-featurelink
description: CloudTAK plugin — bridges CloudTAK to ArcGIS Feature Services (auth, layer browse/download, PLI streaming, send-to-layer)

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm test

//: Dev-only deps so the plugin can typecheck/lint/test in isolation. At build time the plugin is compiled INSIDE CloudTAK, which provides the real versions. CloudTAK's own types are stubbed locally in types/cloudtak.d.ts — the previous 'file:../../../../../CloudTAK/api/web' link pointed outside the repo and made npm ci unreproducible on every machine but the original author's (C-30).
